title: Stage representatives on the finite hypercohomology graded pieces
statement: Let I be a small cofiltered category, D:I→Scheme a diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes with affine transitions and limit cone c. Let F_i be complexes of abelian etale sheaves with compatible unital inverse-image transitions and F_i^n=0 for n<a, using the canonical composition isomorphisms. Let G:I^op→CochainComplex on c.pt be the inverse-image diagram with its compatible isomorphisms eG, and L its colimit cocone. Fix p in Z. Let P be canonical degree-p derived pullback (specified by the derived adjunction unit), H:I^op→AddCommGrpCat the degree-p stage hypercohomology diagram via compatible isomorphisms eH, and B a cocone on H with an isomorphism eB to the degree-p hypercohomology of L.pt intertwining its legs with P and the colimit complex maps. Set N=max(p+1-a,0). There is an antitone sequence S_n of additive subgroups of B.pt, S_0=B.pt and S_N=0, such that for n<N and x in S_n there exist i and y in H(i) with x-B_i(y) in S_(n+1). This lifts one coset, before combining the graded pieces. The notions are those of [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], and [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition].

proof.text: Choose the directed spectral diagram, its compatible comparison maps, the finite target filtration S, and its stage quotient models from the first-page/abutment construction. This establishes only page-one comparison; for each n<N it supplies a common finite page r and quotient maps q,t_j compatible with v.

Form Q by evaluating page r at (p-a-n,a+n), and form its cocone C with legs given by v. Compatibility of v proves naturality. The finite-page comparison theorem applies to page-one continuity, proving that ψ=colimit.desc Q C is an isomorphism.

For x in S_n, surjectivity of ψ gives a colimit preimage of q(x). Since the forgetful functor of abelian groups preserves filtered colimits, Concrete.colimit_exists_rep supplies a stage j and w representing that preimage. Surjectivity of t_j lifts w to y in T_j. Compatibility identifies q(B_(k(j))(y)) with q(x). The subgroup difference lies in S_n and its q-image is zero by additivity. The kernel equation therefore puts x-B_(k(j))(y) in S_(n+1). The original stage k(j) and the underlying y are the required witnesses.

theorem exists_etale_complex_graded_class_rep
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : I, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, CochainComplex (Sheaf (D.obj i).smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : j ⟶ i),
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
        (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id i)))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (F i) ≫
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj i))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : j ⟶ i) (g : k ⟶ j),
      φ (g ≫ f) =
        (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
          (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g) (D.map f)
            (D.map (g ≫ f)) (D.map_comp g f))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (a : ℤ) (hbelow : ∀ (i : I) (n : ℤ), n < a → IsZero ((F i).X n))
    (G : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj (op i) ≅
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app i)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : j ⟶ i), G.map f.op =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
          (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app j) (D.map f)
            (c.π.app i) (c.w f).symm) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app j)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (p : ℤ)
    (P : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
      (K : CochainComplex (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ),
      (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Y p).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ⟶
      (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X p).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K)))
    (hP : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
      (K : CochainComplex (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ),
      P f K = (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} p).map
        ((rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} Y).map
          ((mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).unit.app
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) ≫
        (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorCompIso'
          (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f)
          (Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
          (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f)
              (Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
                terminalIsTerminal) ≪≫
            lowerStarCompSheafSectionsTerminalIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f ≪≫
            (Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
              terminalIsTerminal).symm)).hom.app
                ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapDerivedCategory.obj
                  (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) ≫
        (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X).map
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app K)))
    (H : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj (op i) ≅
      (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj i) p).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (F i)))
    (hH : ∀ (i j : I) (f : j ⟶ i), H.map f.op =
      (eH i).hom ≫ P (D.map f) (F i) ≫
        (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj j) p).map
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map (φ f)) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L)
    (B : Cocone H)
    (eB : B.pt ≅ (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} c.pt p).obj
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L.pt))
    (hB : ∀ i : I, B.ι.app (op i) ≫ eB.hom =
      (eH i).hom ≫ P (c.π.app i) (F i) ≫
        (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} c.pt p).map
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app (op i)))) :
    ∃ S : ℕ → AddSubgroup B.pt,
      S 0 = ⊤ ∧ S (p + 1 - a).toNat = ⊥ ∧ Antitone S ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ), n < (p + 1 - a).toNat → ∀ x : B.pt, x ∈ S n →
        ∃ (i : I) (y : H.obj (op i)),
          @Sub.sub B.pt inferInstance x (B.ι.app (op i) y) ∈ S (n + 1)
